title: Customers Delete does NOT let the user delete customer payments (that needs Invoicing & payments Delete)
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View, Create & Edit and Delete, Invoicing & payments Delete OFF, See Financial Data ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open a customer that has past payments.
  2. Go to the customer's Payments tab.
  3. Look for a Delete option on a payment.
  4. Try to delete a payment.
custom_expected:
There is no Delete option on payments.

The user cannot delete the payment — deleting payments needs Invoicing & payments Delete, not Customers Delete.
